limitHintAnonymous: Not signed in: up to {max} probes per test (Globalping anonymous limit).
limitHintProxy: Signed in with the shared account: up to {max} probes per test.
locHint: Empty fields are ignored. Magic accepts free-form matching such as "Berlin+Germany", "AS13335" or "Western Europe". Type to get matching suggestions.
resultsPlaceholder: Enter a target and press "Run test" to measure from probes around the world.
resultPending: This probe has not returned a result yet.
resultOffline: This probe went offline before returning a result.
resultFailed: This probe could not run the measurement.
httpBodyTruncated: The API truncated the body; only the first part is shown.
quotaResetBackToLocal: Your own quota has reset — switched back to it.
quotaProxyUnavailable: The shared account quota is unavailable; using your own quota.
quotaDirectUnreachable: globalping.io is unreachable from this browser; using the server-side proxy.
quotaLocalExhausted: Your hourly quota is used up.
quotaLocalExhaustedHint: Your own 250 requests/hour quota is used up. Wait for it to reset, or sign in to use the shared account quota.
noRouteAvailable: No route is available for this measurement.
noRouteAvailableHint: Neither your own quota nor the server-side proxy is usable right now. Wait for the hourly quota to reset, or sign in to use the shared account quota.
viaDirect: Using your own quota, requests go straight to globalping.io.
viaProxy: Using the shared account quota through the server-side proxy.
fallbackToProxy: Falling back to the shared account quota.
errorNoProbesFound: No matching probes are available. Loosen the location filters or try again later.
errorValidation: The request parameters are invalid. Please check the form.
errorNotFound: This measurement could not be found; it may have expired or been cleaned up upstream.
errorUnauthorized: Sign in to use the shared account quota.
errorTooManyRequests: The quota is used up or requests are too frequent. Please try again later.
errorPayloadTooLarge: The request payload is too large. Please reduce the parameters and try again.
errorUpstream: The Globalping API is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errorProxyUnavailable: The shared account quota is not configured on this site and is unavailable.
logoutConfirm: Sign out of this site only, or also end your single sign-on session?
